Stage 7p0 v2rayNG reference notes

Reference-only source: uploaded v2rayNG Android project.
License boundary: GPL-3.0; do not copy implementation code into Zap2GUIfLin
without an explicit licensing decision.

Concepts worth borrowing:
- parse vless:// share links into a neutral profile model;
- generate core config separately from profile storage;
- expose a loopback SOCKS inbound, commonly around 127.0.0.1:10808;
- keep proxy-only and VPN/TUN modes separate;
- treat per-app proxy as a product goal, not as portable Android code.

Zap2 adaptation:
- first MVP uses an owner-supplied external core binary;
- generated configs and logs live under .zap2/tunnel;
- local SOCKS binds to loopback only;
- Discord launch wrapper/probe proves whether Discord actually uses SOCKS;
- user connection strings are secrets and must be redacted from docs/tests/logs.
